top_signals.title: US clears way for $24.3 billion fighter jet sale to Saudi Arabia
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Department of State said on Thursday it had approved the potential sale of Lockheed Martin’s F-35 Lightning II fighter jets to Saudi Arabia.
